create_logger_with_file_and_console_hand: create a logger with file and console handlers using create_logger with a filepath and process rank
create_LogFormatter_for_custom_log_prefi: create a LogFormatter instance that adds level name, timestamp, and elapsed time to log messages
reset_logger_elapsed_time: reset the logger elapsed time counter by calling the reset_time method attached to the logger
create_PD_Stats_for_pandas_backed_loggin: create a PD_Stats object with a file path and column list to log statistics as a pickled DataFrame
update_PD_Stats_with_new_row: update a PD_Stats instance with a new row of data and optionally save to the pickle file
